lead.headline: Wilson still in the protocol; Kamara takes the FLEX
lead.deck: Two DNPs and 'doubtful' reporting for Wilson; Tuten 8.9 in a blowout; Allgeier in the FLEX is the one fix.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Wednesday and Thursday in the concussion protocol and reports call a Week 9 return doubtful; Alvin Kamara's back kept him to a limited Thursday; Bhayshul Tuten scored on the opening drive at Baltimore and then watched Ameer Abdullah take the second half of a 33-10 rout, 8.9 points. The fix is small: the owner put Tyler Allgeier into Wilson's FLEX last night, and Kamara projects 1.9 higher — a coin flip the projection takes. Swap them, check Friday's Jets report for a Wilson clearance, and check the 10:30 inactive list Sunday.

players.caption: Kamara: limited Thursday, into the FLEX

doFirst.headline: Kamara into the FLEX before Sunday 12:00
doFirst.deck: Swap Kamara for Allgeier; Wilson only if the Jets clear him; Allgeier back if Kamara is inactive at 10:30.
doFirst.note: The swap itself is on the brief's Do-first. The card here is Sunday's fallback. Nothing on the wire beats a starter.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do but the Kamara swap.

cards.headline: If Kamara is inactive Sunday, Allgeier goes back in
cards.reason: Back: rest-day DNP, then limited Thursday. Friday's report and the 10:30 list decide.

roster.deck: 3.5 below the projection lineup on paper; Wilson's protocol is the override, and Kamara over Allgeier is the coin flip that closes most of it.

wire.headline: Nothing clears the bar
wire.deck: Thursday's movers are a Tuten handcuff and a garbage-time run; Kaelon Black is the free-agent watch if McCaffrey is ruled out.
